notes.title: Patch Note 1.02
notes.content:
Finally! 
Chinese voiceovers are in.
Also fixed a bunch of bugs :P
To celebrate the new content launch, we started a 10% discount for everyone, Enjoy!

[spoiler]Added option to skip the prologue
Repaired some models
Fixed issues relating to loading a saved game or new game, including placeable items and NPC/game progress
Fixed animations and character movements
Removed debug button to pause countdown timer
Updated Demo puzzle page
Fixed character model issue for after jumping off the building
Replaced illegible pictures
Fixed issue with “read view” displaying placeholder text
[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.01
notes.content:
Midnight hotfix!

- Show the version number on the title screen
[spoiler] 
- Fixed body mesh clipping while using binoculars
- Fixed the email notification sound not stopping when leaving the living room
- Fixed an issue with temple doors not opening after loading the game
- Fixed an issue where police email addresses, when uppercased, could not be logged in
- Fixed an issue when pressing P causes HUD to disappear and clock to pause
- Fixed a LOD issue at the dock area
[/spoiler]

If you have any further feedback, don't hesitate to tell us in our Discord Server!

Have fun detectives XD

notes.title: Demo available now till Oct 7th!
notes.content:
To Celebrate the date announcement for Keyword: A Spider's thread public release on September 28th, we reactivated the Demo for everyone to play again and added a secret puzzle at the end. 

Beat the demo and solve the secret puzzle for a chance to win ANY game of your choice! 

Step 1
Download The Keyword: A Spider’s Thread Demo on Steam
Use your detective skills to find the hidden puzzle webpage. 

Step 2
Solve the puzzle. Submit your answer and email on the website. Our “investigation agency” will randomly select a few detectives to receive Steam gift cards ($3-5 USD in value).

More rewards
If you didn’t receive a gift card, you’ll have another chance!
Every detective that solves the puzzle will receive a unique detective ID number. Retweet or comment this post with your detective ID and #KeywordASpidersThread for a chance to win:

A copy of Journal 29: Interactive Book Game* x 3
A Steam game of your choice**  x 1


*USA and Canada only. Winners outside of these jurisdictions will receive a gift card ($18 USD in value).
**Restrictions apply. Game must be available on Steam with a MSRP of $60 USD or less. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662971/f646737e8f417f859035c6facb7cf3a942de0812.png

Have fun!!
